mechanism: Both agents cause CNS depression and dopamine antagonism; deutetrabenazine is a VMAT2 inhibitor that increases dopamine depletion while quetiapine is an antipsychotic, creating additive effects on motor control and CNS function.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation, orthostatic hypotension, and worsening of motor symptoms; dose adjustments may be needed and concurrent use requires careful clinical oversight.
